sculpt_ground_tor_b.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_ground_tor_b.notes: Facet stone (tor_b) for the landmark rock set pieces: exact planes with bevelled edges, beds / joints / drill marks as geometry, moss cushion as its own primitive (Moss_none). Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, neutral stone ~#9b9b9b). LOD tris 733 / 389 / 131. Origin = foot centre, ~1 m unit; src/world/landforms/setpieces.js fits it into each piece's box.
